title: Graceful Gemini overload error handling (503/429), exponential backoff retry before token emission, clean SSE stream closure, and UI retry
assumptions: Single Gemini model is used (fallback model omitted per user request).
Retries before any token is sent will use exponential backoff with jitter up to ~20s total cap.
Stream closes gracefully with an SSE error event and cleans up empty assistant messages on frontend.
